title: Grilled Korean-Style Soybean Sprouts with Earthy Notes
description: A flavorful and nutritious side dish featuring soybean sprouts, earthy undertones, and a hint of Syrian spice.

ingredients.name: Earthy sesame oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality sesame oil for the best flavor

instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) for the soybeans.
Roast the soybeans in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until fragrant and lightly browned.
In a separate pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the soybean paste, za'atar, and a pinch of salt to the pan. Stir to combine.
Add the soybean sprouts to the pan and stir to coat with the sauce.
If using mushrooms, slice them and add to the pan for the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
